aether.name: Aether
aether.freeTier: Free plan: 20 credits a month at no cost, permanently (about 2 hours of the 2 vCPU / 8 GB Medium size).

agent37.name: Agent37 Cloud
agent37.freeTier: One-time $5 starter credit after adding a card (the card is not charged), for new accounts; up to 3 instances running at once until the first top-up.

airtop.name: Airtop
airtop.freeTier: Free plan with 1,000 credits every month and 3 simultaneous sessions, plus a one-time signup credit bonus in the first month.

alibaba-agent-sandbox.name: Alibaba Cloud Agent Sandbox
alibaba-agent-sandbox.freeTier: No free trial or monthly allowance is stated for Agent Sandbox; only the first 15 GiB of disk on an active sandbox is free.

amp.name: Amp
amp.freeTier: No free hosted orb time. The Hobby tier itself is free, and self-hosted orbs or your own runners cost nothing on Hobby, Individual and Teams tiers, but Amp-hosted orbs are pay-as-you-go.

anchor-browser.name: Anchor Browser
anchor-browser.freeTier: Free plan with 5 credits ($5 of usage) every month, up to 5 concurrent browsers.

anthropic-sandbox-runtime.name: Anthropic sandbox-runtime
anthropic-sandbox-runtime.freeTier: Free open-source software under the Apache-2.0 license.

archil.name: Archil
archil.freeTier: Free plan: each month 1 vCPU-hour and 2 GiB-hours of sandbox compute (an hour of the default 1 vCPU / 2 GiB sandbox), 1,000 tool calls and 5 disks of up to 10 GB; hard caps with no overage.

aws-agentcore-code-interpreter.name: AWS Bedrock AgentCore Code Interpreter
aws-agentcore-code-interpreter.freeTier: No Code Interpreter free allowance. New AWS customers receive up to $200 in AWS Free Tier credits usable across AWS.

aws-lambda-microvms.name: AWS Lambda MicroVMs
aws-lambda-microvms.freeTier: No MicroVMs free allowance is listed. New AWS customers receive up to $200 in AWS Free Tier credits usable across AWS.

aws-nitro-sandboxes.name: AWS Nitro Sandboxes
aws-nitro-sandboxes.freeTier: The sandbox feature and its EKS and ECS integrations cost nothing extra, but there is no free compute: you pay standard EC2 prices for the parent instances.

azure-dynamic-sessions.name: Azure Container Apps dynamic sessions
azure-dynamic-sessions.freeTier: No dynamic sessions free allowance is listed. New Azure customers can get a $200 credit to use within 30 days.

beam.name: Beam
beam.freeTier: No free tier or trial credit is stated on the pricing page; the cheapest plan is $20 a month with $20 of credit.

bitrise-rde.name: Bitrise Remote Dev Environments
bitrise-rde.freeTier: 14-day free trial with Tier 1 allocation (8 hours per OS, 1 concurrent VM). A credit card is required at signup for verification but is not charged, the trial does not convert to a paid plan automatically, and trial sessions are limited to eight hours.

bitrise.name: Bitrise CI
bitrise.freeTier: Hobby plan: free forever with 500 build minutes a month on Linux or macOS. New sign-ups also get a 30-day trial of the paid plans.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.freeTier: 3,000 free minutes every month; no credit card required to start. The pricing page does not say which runner size the free minutes are counted on.

blaxel.name: Blaxel
blaxel.freeTier: Up to $200 in free credits at sign-up; Tier 0 quotas (10 sandboxes, 7-day maximum sandbox lifetime). Promotional credits do not count toward tier upgrades.

boat.name: boat
boat.freeTier: 7-day free trial on the first plan, card required: 25 compute hours in total, 2 sandboxes at once, small and default sizes only, auto-stop of 2 hours at most, no saved snapshots. There is no free tier without a card.

boxd.name: boxd
boxd.freeTier: 30 of free credits (EUR or USD, by the organization's currency) when a payment method is added; nothing is charged when the card is added.

boxes-dev.name: boxes.dev
boxes-dev.freeTier: Trial: free, 20 box-hours per user (worth $8 at the extra-usage rate), 3 awake devboxes plus the Template box, up to 2 projects. It is a one-time trial per user that starts at first machine use; some teams must add a payment method first.

browser-use.name: Browser Use Cloud
browser-use.freeTier: One-time $1 signup credit, one per person.

browserbase.name: Browserbase
browserbase.freeTier: Free plan: 1 browser hour per month, 3 concurrent browsers and 15-minute sessions, no credit card; usage stops at the allowance.

browserless.name: Browserless
browserless.freeTier: Free plan: 1,000 units (30-second blocks) every month, 2 concurrent browsers, 2-minute sessions, no card required.

buildkite.name: Buildkite hosted agents
buildkite.freeTier: Free plan with up to 2,000 Linux vCPU-minutes a month (about 16.7 hours on the 2 vCPU Small shape). New organizations also get a 30-day all-access trial with no credit card.

claude-code-web.name: Claude Code on the web
claude-code-web.freeTier: None. The Free Claude plan does not include Claude Code; cloud sessions need Pro, Max, Ultra, Team or an eligible Enterprise seat.

cloudflare-dynamic-workers.name: Cloudflare Dynamic Workers
cloudflare-dynamic-workers.freeTier: None. Dynamic Workers are only available on the Workers Paid plan ($5/month minimum), which includes a monthly usage allowance.

cloudflare-sandbox.name: Cloudflare Sandbox SDK
cloudflare-sandbox.freeTier: None for sandboxes: Containers require the Workers Paid plan ($5/month), which includes 375 vCPU-minutes, 25 GiB-hours of memory and 200 GB-hours of disk each month.

coder.name: Coder
coder.freeTier: Community edition is free and open source (AGPL-3.0) with unlimited workspaces and templates, up to 5 active Coder Agents and 1 platform integration.

codesandbox.name: CodeSandbox
codesandbox.freeTier: Build plan: free, with 400 VM credits each month (unused credits do not roll over) and up to 10 concurrent VMs.

containarium.name: Containarium
containarium.freeTier: Self-hosting is free under Apache-2.0. The hosted cloud has no free tier listed.

createos.name: CreateOS Sandbox
createos.freeTier: New accounts start with 500 free credits, no card required; the Free plan allows one sandbox at a time.

cubesandbox.name: Tencent CubeSandbox
cubesandbox.freeTier: Free open-source software, licensed Apache-2.0 apart from listed third-party components.

cursor-cloud-agents.name: Cursor cloud agents
cursor-cloud-agents.freeTier: None. The Free and Plus ($8/month) plans do not include cloud agents.

daytona.name: Daytona
daytona.freeTier: $200 in free compute on sign-up, no credit card required; free credits cannot be used for GPU sandboxes. Startups can apply for up to $50k in credits.

depot.name: Depot
depot.freeTier: 7-day free trial, no credit card required.

devin.name: Devin
devin.freeTier: None for cloud sessions. The $0 Free plan has a light quota for local agent use; access to cloud agents (Devin Cloud) starts with Pro.

digitalocean-harness-runtime.name: DigitalOcean Agent Harness Runtime
digitalocean-harness-runtime.freeTier: New customers receive a one-time $5 promotional credit for Managed Agents usage.

docker-sandboxes.name: Docker Sandboxes
docker-sandboxes.freeTier: The sbx CLI and local sandbox compute are free, including for commercial work. Cloud sign-ups get a one-time promotional credit (amount not stated).

e2b-runtime.name: E2B open-source runtime
e2b-runtime.freeTier: Free open-source software under the Apache-2.0 license. E2B's hosted cloud and dedicated enterprise deployments are separate offerings.

e2b.name: E2B
e2b.freeTier: Hobby plan: $0/month with a one-time $100 usage credit, no credit card required; 1-hour sessions and 10 concurrent sandboxes.

exe-dev.name: exe.dev
exe-dev.freeTier: Personal plan free trial for 7 days.

factory.name: Factory
factory.freeTier: No free hosted compute is stated. The Free plan is free to use with your own model keys or subscriptions, but its access to Factory-hosted cloud computers is not described.

firecracker.name: Firecracker
firecracker.freeTier: Free open-source software under the Apache-2.0 license.

fly-sprites.name: Fly.io Sprites
fly-sprites.freeTier: Every new Fly.io account gets a one-time $1 trial credit (no credit card, lasts 7 days); invoices under $5 are waived.

freestyle.name: Freestyle
freestyle.freeTier: Free plan with a monthly allowance (same on every plan) of 200 vCPU-hours, 400 GiB-hours of memory, 60,000 GiB-hours of storage, plus 50 GB data transfer; no usage charges, allowances are hard stops. Adding a card charges a refunded $1 verification.

github-actions-runners.name: GitHub-hosted runners
github-actions-runners.freeTier: Standard runners are free and unlimited in public repositories. For private repositories every plan includes a monthly compute allowance: $12 on GitHub Free (2,000 standard Linux minutes).

github-codespaces.name: GitHub Codespaces
github-codespaces.freeTier: Personal accounts: 120 core-hours and 15 GB-months a month on GitHub Free, 180 core-hours and 20 GB-months on GitHub Pro. Organization plans include no free quota.

github-copilot-coding-agent.name: GitHub Copilot coding agent
github-copilot-coding-agent.freeTier: None for cloud sessions: Copilot Free does not include Copilot in the cloud. Paid Copilot users get a monthly included compute amount from their GitHub account plan ($12 on GitHub Free, $18 on GitHub Pro) that covers sandbox compute and memory.

google-cloud-workstations.name: Google Cloud Workstations
google-cloud-workstations.freeTier: New Google Cloud customers get $300 in free credit; there is no free allowance specific to Cloud Workstations.

gvisor.name: gVisor
gvisor.freeTier: Free open-source software under the Apache-2.0 license.

hopx.name: Hopx
hopx.freeTier: $200 in free credits for new accounts, no credit card required. The site does not say whether the credits expire.

hyperbrowser.name: Hyperbrowser
hyperbrowser.freeTier: Free account with 5,000 credits ($5), enough for about 50 browser-hours; 1 concurrent session; upgrade required once used.

instabox.name: InstaBox
instabox.freeTier: Free plan: one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine that is never billed, with a fixed 20 GiB disk, 5 snapshots and 100 GiB egress a month; it pauses after 30 idle minutes, and each run is limited to 120 minutes at first, growing with use up to 480 minutes.

islo.name: Islo
islo.freeTier: Every new workspace gets a 7-day free trial of the Team plan, no credit card needed. Islo's site summary for AI tools also describes the Team trial as up to $200.

isorun.name: Isorun
isorun.freeTier: $50 of free credit for new accounts, no card required (about 1,250 hours of the default 1 vCPU / 1 GiB sandbox).

judge0.name: Judge0
judge0.freeTier: Self-hosting the open-source version is free with no limits; the hosted Basic plan includes 50 submissions per day at no cost.

kata-containers.name: Kata Containers
kata-containers.freeTier: Free open-source software under the Apache-2.0 license.

kernel.name: Kernel
kernel.freeTier: Developer plan: $5 of usage credit every month, 5 concurrent browsers, no credit card required.

kortix.name: Kortix
kortix.freeTier: 500 credits ($5) every month on the first workspace, about 45 hours of the default 2 vCPU / 4 GB computer. Later workspaces start with no free credits.

kosa8.name: kosa8 Cloud
kosa8.freeTier: Starter: $10 of kosa8 Cloud usage once, with no card and no time limit, after you confirm your email. It runs 2 sandboxes at once, each up to 2 vCPU / 4 GB, in sessions of up to 60 minutes, with outbound network limited to an allow-list; work stops at the limit and Starter never sends a bill. Anyone can also try 15 minutes of run time per 24 hours on kosa8's website without an account.

koyeb-sandboxes.name: Koyeb Sandboxes
koyeb-sandboxes.freeTier: No free sandbox usage is stated. Koyeb's one free instance is for a single web service and is not offered for sandboxes.

kubernetes-agent-sandbox.name: Kubernetes Agent Sandbox
kubernetes-agent-sandbox.freeTier: Free open-source software under Apache-2.0. On GKE it is offered at no extra charge; normal GKE pricing applies to the resources you create.

langsmith-sandboxes.name: LangSmith Sandboxes
langsmith-sandboxes.freeTier: Every plan, including the free Developer plan, includes 8 LSU (US$8) of sandbox usage each month. Developer is limited to 10 sandboxes.

lightpanda.name: Lightpanda Cloud
lightpanda.freeTier: Explorer plan: 10 browser hours every month, free with no end date, 5 concurrent sessions.

lizard.name: Lizard Sandboxes
lizard.freeTier: 7-day Pro trial with $5 of usage; a card is required but nothing is charged during the 7 days. The trial runs at most 1 Small, 2 Mini and 2 Nano sandboxes at a time, in US regions only, and deletes each after at most 1 hour.

maritime.name: Maritime
maritime.freeTier: 7-day free trial on Starter terms with up to $20 of usage. A card is needed to start the first machine but is not charged unless the trial is not cancelled, in which case $20 is charged on day 7 as that month's credit.

microsandbox.name: microsandbox
microsandbox.freeTier: Free open-source software under the Apache-2.0 license; no hosted paid tier with a published price was found.

microsoft-nvx.name: Microsoft NVX
microsoft-nvx.freeTier: Free open-source software under the MIT license.

miosa.name: MIOSA
miosa.freeTier: Free plan: $1 of usage every month with no overage; machines pause at a $0 balance.

modal.name: Modal Sandboxes
modal.freeTier: Starter plan: $0/month with $30 of compute credit every month (CPU, memory, GPU for Functions and Sandboxes).

morph.name: Morph Cloud
morph.freeTier: Conflicting: the pricing page lists the free Developer tier with 0 starting MCUs ('Purchase credits to use compute'), while the Plans doc says 300 MCUs free and the FAQ/Signing Up docs say 300 free compute hours per month. Access may require an invite.

mosaic-sandbox.name: Mosaic Sandbox
mosaic-sandbox.freeTier: No free tier or trial credit is stated on the pricing or signup pages.

namespace.name: Namespace Devboxes
namespace.freeTier: 30-day free trial of the Developer plan on sign-up, including Devboxes; no credit card required. The pricing page does not state how much usage the trial covers.

northflank.name: Northflank
northflank.freeTier: Free Sandbox plan: up to $20/month of resources on Northflank Cloud (2 services, 2 jobs, 1 database), no card needed.

novita-sandbox.name: Novita Agent Sandbox
novita-sandbox.freeTier: No free credit is stated. The free tier is the starting quota for new accounts (5 concurrent sandboxes, 1-hour sessions, up to 2 vCPU / 4 GiB per sandbox), and its usage is charged to the account balance, including any vouchers.

nvidia-openshell.name: NVIDIA OpenShell
nvidia-openshell.freeTier: Free open-source software under the Apache-2.0 license.

okteto.name: Okteto
okteto.freeTier: Starter: free self-hosted license for up to 5 users and 500 environments a month, valid for one year, no credit card needed.

openai-codex.name: OpenAI Codex cloud
openai-codex.freeTier: No free cloud tasks. The Free ($0) and Go ($8/month) ChatGPT plans list Codex only in the desktop app; cloud tasks start with Plus.

opencomputer.name: OpenComputer
opencomputer.freeTier: 3-day free trial with 600 work minutes and $10 of model tokens, no card; it ends at 600 minutes or day 3, whichever comes first.

orgo.name: Orgo
orgo.freeTier: Free account: $5 starting credit (or $2 for an agent signup) that runs one Medium Linux computer by the hour.

podflare.name: Podflare
podflare.freeTier: New accounts get $200 of credit, which applies to both subscription and usage fees; no card hold during the private alpha.

promigence.name: Promigence
promigence.freeTier: $10 of free credit with no card, and $40 more once a card is added, for 30 days. It comes with the invite code needed to sign up, and the first $10 is claimed in the browser.

railway-sandboxes.name: Railway Sandboxes
railway-sandboxes.freeTier: Free plan with $1 of usage credit each month, after a 30-day trial with a one-time $5 credit. Sandboxes are available on Free and the trial, capped at 2 vCPU / 2 GB.

render.name: Render Sandboxes
render.freeTier: No free sandbox usage is stated. The Hobby workspace has no monthly fee, but sandbox compute is billed at the usage rates; Render's free compute plans cover web services, Key Value and Postgres only.

replit.name: Replit
replit.freeTier: A 3-day free trial of Core after sign-up, for eligible new users; who is eligible and whether a card is needed are not stated. The free Starter plan no longer takes new users; those already on it keep a limited free allowance for Replit AI, monthly cloud credits and one published app.

riza.name: Riza Code Interpreter API
riza.freeTier: Hobby plan is free with up to 100,000 requests per month, 30-second executions and 3 custom runtimes.

runloop.name: Runloop
runloop.freeTier: New accounts start on a Pro trial with a one-time $50 usage credit and no credit card (3 concurrent Devboxes, sizes up to MEDIUM, 1-hour max keep-alive). After that, the Basic plan has no monthly fee and bills usage only.

runs-on.name: RunsOn
runs-on.freeTier: 15-day free trial of Starter, Growth or Scale (payment details collected at checkout); AWS usage during the trial is billed by AWS. Open-source, non-profit and personal non-commercial projects get a free license.

sailboxes.name: Sailboxes
sailboxes.freeTier: Free plan: $5 of credit every month after a payment method is attached; usage beyond it is paid from prepaid credits.

sandbase.name: SandBase
sandbase.freeTier: Sandboxes are free for now, with possible fair-use caps. SandBase says it will announce pricing before this changes.

sandbox0.name: Sandbox0
sandbox0.freeTier: One-time $5 usage credit for eligible new users after a credit card is saved; adding the card charges nothing.

simular-box.name: Box by Simular
simular-box.freeTier: 5,000 box credits once ($5), valid 90 days: about 25 hours of box time on the Free box (4 vCPU / 8 GB) at 200 credits an hour.

solo-agent-substrate.name: Solo Enterprise for Agent Substrate
solo-agent-substrate.freeTier: The open-source kagent and Agent Substrate projects are free to run yourself. The enterprise release, with support, single sign-on, access control, tracing and air-gapped installs, needs license keys priced by quote from Solo.io sales.

steel.name: Steel
steel.freeTier: $30 of one-time credit on the Launch plan, valid for 90 days, no credit card needed.

superserve.name: Superserve
superserve.freeTier: Start free with no card: a new account gets a limited free trial for its first sandbox (the credit amount is not stated). Trial sandboxes can use up to 2 vCPU and 4 GiB memory. After the trial credit is used, a card and a plan are required.

tembo.name: Tembo
tembo.freeTier: 7-day free trial of the Max plan with an included usage allowance (amount not stated), up to 10 users and sandboxes up to 16 vCPU / 32 GiB. Sessions stop when the trial or its allowance ends; no overage billing during the trial.

tenki.name: Luxor Agent Cloud Sandbox
tenki.freeTier: One-time $100 in free credits the first time a payment method is added; nothing is credited before a card is on file. Adding the card also turns on auto-reload, which adds $20 whenever the balance drops below $5, and can be turned off.

tensorlake.name: Tensorlake Sandboxes
tensorlake.freeTier: Free plan at $0 with no credit card: 1 sandbox at a time with 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM and 10 GB disk, sessions up to 2 hours, unmetered.

thunder-compute.name: Thunder Compute
thunder-compute.freeTier: No free tier or trial credit is stated on the pricing or billing pages.

ubicloud.name: Ubicloud GitHub Actions runners
ubicloud.freeTier: $2.5 credit every month, equal to 1,250 minutes on the 2 vCPU standard runner. A credit card is required to start.

upstash-box.name: Upstash Box
upstash-box.freeTier: Free plan: 5 CPU hours per month and up to 10 concurrent boxes.

vercel-sandbox.name: Vercel Sandbox
vercel-sandbox.freeTier: Hobby: free monthly allowance of 5 Active CPU hours, 420 GB-hours of memory, 5,000 creations and 20 GB data transfer; no overage billing, creation pauses until the next cycle.

warpbuild.name: WarpBuild
warpbuild.freeTier: One-time $10 credit on signup, no credit card required; a payment method is needed once the free credit is used.

workpaper.name: Workpaper
workpaper.freeTier: Free trial with no account and no card: 60 minutes on one small computer, with internet limited to code and package sites and AI model APIs; one trial per device every 30 days. New accounts also get one free hour of credit with full internet.
